functions.name: _permitted_forms_checked
functions.input: zone code and council name for one lot
functions.output: permitted engine forms plus a plain reason when the table was not read
functions.if_none: missing zone or council returns an empty set with a reason, never a bare empty set

functions.name: _capacity_ceiling
functions.input: zone, council, location, lot area, heritage and width range
functions.output: floor, ceiling or None, LMR flag, citation and a reason for both callers
functions.if_none: an unknown table gives ceiling None plus the reason, or the LMR uplift if eligible

values.if_missing: no gap; ceiling from the table as before

queries.purpose: councils that have an LEP land use table (coverage)
queries.where_clause: none (SELECT DISTINCT lga over a small reference table)
queries.if_zero: every council reads as not held: shown as not known, never one house
queries.if_wrong: a council wrongly treated as not held shows not known instead of its forms
